speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Lymphoma (likely Hodgkin Lymphoma or Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma given B-symptoms, lymphadenopathy, and elevated LDH). The combination of drenching night sweats, significant weight loss, supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, and elevated LDH strongly suggests a hematologic malignancy; the abdominal pain may indicate splenomegaly or hepatic involvement.
